newsitem.title: LATVIA: OLAINE PEAT ON OFFER FROM APRIL 14 - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: OLAINE PEAT ON OFFER FROM APRIL 14 - REPORT.

text.p: Olaine peat factory, just outside RIga, will have 20.5 percent of its basic capital sold in public offer, privatisation agency (LPA) officials were quoted by Diena Bizness newspaper as saying on Monday.
Some 246,00 shares, worth 1.2 million lats, will be sold for privatisation vouchers from April 14 until May 9.

The Mono company bought the controling stake in Olaine earlier in March for 612,00 lats. It has to pay 35 percent of the sum in cash during the next three years and the remainder in privatisation vouchers.
Olaine Peat registered 15,000 lats after-tax profit on turnover of 781,100 lats in 1996, LPA official Maris Paeglis is quoted as saying.
